name: samebase-monorepo
description: Samebase monorepo with PNPM and Vite+ tooling

scripts.check: pnpm run check:workspace && pnpm run check:root
scripts.check:ci: vp run check:workspace:ci && pnpm run check:root
scripts.check:plugin: vp fmt --check packages/plugin && node scripts/check-samebase-agent-plugin.ts && node scripts/check-agent-plugin-logo.ts
scripts.check:packages: pnpm run check:plugin && vp run --fail-if-no-match --filter @samebase/sure --filter @samebase/dependent --filter @samebase/git-editor --filter @samebase/logo-model --filter @samebase/sidebars --filter @samebase/onboarding-video-tools --filter @samebase/identity-broker --filter @samebase/alchemy-convex --filter identity-hub check
scripts.check:workspace: vp run --filter samebase check && vp run --filter workspace-layout-v2-solid typecheck:cached && pnpm run check:packages && vp run check:remotion-studio && pnpm run check:examples
scripts.check:scripts: pnpm run check:git-blob-sizes && pnpm run typecheck:scripts && pnpm run warn:tracked-file-paths && pnpm run lint:scripts && pnpm run verify:template-export && pnpm run check:template-sync && pnpm run check:agents-budget
scripts.audit:supply-chain: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && pnpm run audit:signatures && pnpm run audit:vulnerabilities
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter samebase typecheck && vp run --filter workspace-layout-v2-solid typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:packages && vp run typecheck:remotion-studio && pnpm run typecheck:examples && pnpm typecheck:scripts
scripts.typecheck:packages: pnpm --filter @samebase/sure typecheck && pnpm --filter @samebase/dependent typecheck && pnpm --filter @samebase/git-editor typecheck && pnpm --filter @samebase/logo-model typecheck && pnpm --filter @samebase/sidebars typecheck && pnpm --filter @samebase/onboarding-video-tools typecheck
scripts.ci:convex-bootstrap: CONVEX_AGENT_MODE=anonymous pnpm --filter samebase exec convex dev --until-success --typecheck=disable --tail-logs=disable
scripts.clean: rm -rf .turbo .vite coverage test-results apps/samebase/dist apps/samebase/dev-dist apps/samebase/e2e/test-results apps/samebase/e2e/live-test-results apps/sidebars-example/dist
scripts.test:ci: pnpm test && PLAYWRIGHT_VITE_PORT=43121 pnpm --filter samebase test:visual
scripts.lint:scripts: pnpm exec vp lint --tsconfig tsconfig.scripts.json --report-unused-disable-directives apps/samebase/alchemy.run.ts runtime scripts packages/plugin/scripts .devcontainer/postcreate.ts apps/samebase/scripts apps/samebase/postcss.config.ts apps/samebase/tailwind.config.ts
scripts.typecheck:scripts: pnpm run generate:tracked-file-paths && tsgo -p tsconfig.scripts.json --pretty false
